verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting, policy, or opt-out mechanism for preventing user data/code from being used to train AI models (OpenCode's docs focus on providers, agents, permissions, IDE integration, etc., none addressing training-data usage). Community evidence actually suggests the opposite direction of concern: telemetry is sent to OpenCode's own servers even with locally-hosted models with no way to disable it, which further undermines confidence that user data is protected from being retained/used.
